messages:
infra-oncall: paging: seeing a token-tally flicker on prod billing for ~10m. Delta ~+30% vs baseline, several overage flags fired for ACME and BrightCo. Anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: incident created INC-2026-452 metering.token_tally_flicker — paging oncall.

samir.k: taking it — oncall. Quick triage: are we seeing delayed emits or duplicate counts?

maria.p: looking at emitter metrics — consumer lag on kafka topic billing-emits spikes at t-9m, also a small window of proxy retries. logs show repeated POSTs from proxy v2.1.3 to /v1/emits.

billing-ops-bot: FYI automated overage emails triggered for 3 customers (ACME, BrightCo, NovaApps). CS alerted and drafting workaround note.

samir.k: ok, immediate plan: (1) suppress automated overage notifications for affected customers, (2) reduce proxy retry multiplier to limit duplicate emits, (3) restart emitter-3 replica, (4) kick de-dupe backfill.

maria.p: running quick reconciliation:
```
SELECT origin, count(*) as cnt, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM billing.emits
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY origin
ORDER BY tokens DESC
```
results show origin=proxy-v2.1.3 has tokens ~2x expected for several customers -> likely retries causing duplicates.

samir.k: can billing-ops-bot suppress alerts? I don't want customers getting more emails while we triage.

billing-ops-bot: suppression API called for ACME, BrightCo, NovaApps — response 200. Alerts suppressed until manual clear. CS updated. :white_check_mark:

maria.p: reducing proxy retry multiplier from 3 to 1 on staging then prod. Pushing config change now.

eng-lead-ops: oncall handoff in 18m — I will coordinate emitter restart and de-dupe job. If restart doesn't reduce duplicates within 5m, we flip to fallback collector (read-only mode) to stop new counts.

samir.k: good call. I started the emitter-3 restart (kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter --namespace=prod —target=emitter-3). Monitoring logs.

maria.p: logs tail shows fewer duplicate POSTs after proxy config change, consumer lag dropping. Reconciliation sample: token delta now within +4% of baseline for sample customers.

billing-ops-bot: suppression still in place. CS: holding customer comms until we confirm no further spikes.

eng-lead-ops: I'm taking next steps, samir — handing off the incident to me for stabilization and postmortem. Oncall officially transferred.

samir.k: handoff acknowledged. Thanks all — keeping INC-2026-452 open for postmortem items (root cause likely proxy retry backpressure + emitter idempotency gap).

infra-oncall: follow-up action items: add rate-limited de-dup layer at ingress, add canary for retry config changes, and extend metering alerts to include delta-window smoothing.

eng-lead-ops: noted. I'll open follow-up tickets and communicate timeline. Closing active pagers; marking incident as stabilized.

billing-ops-bot: final: 0 additional customers alerted after suppression, CS will notify impacted customers with corrected usage and waived overage where applicable.

infra-oncall: postmortem to be created in 72h after data reconciliation.
